title: SharonAI Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 13, 2026, disclosing receipt of the remaining consideration from the sale of its subsidiary's 50% ownership in the Texas Critical Data Centers joint venture. The filing is classified under Regulation FD disclosure (Item 7.01) and includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine SEC disclosure for a small-cap company (ticker SHAZ, listed on Nasdaq) with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: SharonAI Holdings Inc. (ticker SHAZ) filed Form 8-K on April 13, 2026, reporting accelerated receipt of remaining consideration from a joint venture sale.
The company sold its 50% ownership in a Texas Critical Data Centers joint venture.
